sqlTime.name: SqlTime
sqlTime.description: An ISO-8601 time-only value at second precision used for java.sql.Time.

locale.name: Locale
locale.description: An IETF BCP 47 language tag used for java.util.Locale.

bookmark.name: Bookmark
bookmark.description: A Causeway bookmark in logical-type:identifier form.

applicationFeatureId.name: ApplicationFeatureId
applicationFeatureId.description: A URL-safe encoded Causeway application feature identifier.

password.name: Password
password.description: A protected Causeway password value. Input constructs the value; output is always suppressed.

markup.name: Markup
markup.description: Causeway markup HTML. This scalar is output-only and clients must treat the content as markup.

unsupported.name: UnsupportedValue
unsupported.description: Unsupported Causeway value. Strict output is redacted and input requires an explicit reversible ScalarMarshaller or TypeMapper.
